name: github-multi
description: GitHub MCP with separate work and personal-account access tokens.

GITHUB_TOKEN_WORK.title: GitHub work personal access token
GITHUB_TOKEN_WORK.description: Fine-grained or classic PAT for your work GitHub account. Create at https://github.com/settings/tokens with the repo scopes you want the agent to use.

GITHUB_TOKEN_PERSONAL.title: GitHub personal-account access token
GITHUB_TOKEN_PERSONAL.description: Fine-grained or classic PAT for your personal GitHub account. Create at https://github.com/settings/tokens with the repo scopes you want the agent to use.
